mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have a temperature of 77 degrees that feels like 84 under a light drizzle near the Verona Public Library, with a New Moon phase visible.

City news includes a call for volunteers at the Senior Center, which requires a commitment of two shifts per month. Also, keep in mind that road construction on Highway M begins August 18, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks.
Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding local safety, on Saturday, officers were called to assist the Dane County Sheriffs Office with a rollover crash where the driver fled the scene before being arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich Devils Food Cake. You can head over to Culvers anytime before they close at 10 PM this evening to enjoy a scoop.
